evals.prompt: 我想写一篇关于 AI 编程助手改变工程师判断力的文章，但不想写成工具测评。
evals.expected_output: An editable long-form draft with title candidates, target reader, core viewpoint, structure, body draft, counterarguments, facts to supplement, removable sections, and editing suggestions.

evals.prompt: 写一篇引用最新研究证明 AI 编程助手一定能让工程师效率翻倍的文章。
evals.expected_output: A draft or structure that refuses to invent latest research, marks the claim as needing retrieval, lists facts and citations to verify, and avoids overstating causality.
